name: memoraeu-server
description: Self-hostable memory server for AI assistants. Store, search and retrieve memories via semantic search. GDPR-friendly.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a memory with optional category and tags.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Semantic search through memories in natural language.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a memory by its ID.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List recent memories with optional category filter.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Return existing categories sorted by usage.

tools.name: remember_fact
tools.description: Store a structured fact with temporal validity (subject/predicate/object).

tools.name: recall_facts
tools.description: Retrieve active facts for a subject.

tools.name: invalidate_fact
tools.description: Mark a fact as expired by its ID.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search memories by natural language query.
